purpose: Teach: 差額/草案/均一/雇っ/宛て/簿記/終身/巻き込ん

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合との価格の差額、お客様、敏感ですから、注意しましょう、必ず。
lines.en: Customers are very sensitive about price differences with our competitors. We need to be careful about that.
lines.style: Crisp, measured tone. Open clearly on the problem statement. Businesslike but not cold. Settle slightly on 'careful' — it's a directive wrapped in care, not just a rule.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新企画の草案、社員、意見、続々と、寄せてくれています、熱意、感じます。
lines.en: Yes. The team has been submitting their opinions on the new project draft continuously. I can really feel their enthusiasm.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Build energy on 'submitting' — it's good news. The slight lift in voice at the end when naming the enthusiasm, like he's impressed and wants her to see it too.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各支店、サービス、均一に、提供できる体制、整えていきましょう、お客様向けに。
lines.en: So let's work on setting up a system where we can deliver consistent service across all branches for our customers.
lines.style: Forward-focused, collaborative rhythm. Speak 'consistent service' as a unified goal, not a checklist. Steady pace, inclusive in tone — 'let's' carries the weight here.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専門スタッフ、追加で、雇って、現場、強化いたしました、若手も、頼もしいです。
lines.en: Yes. We've brought on additional specialist staff to strengthen the branch operations, and honestly, the younger team members are proving really solid.
lines.style: Reporting with quiet pride. Not overplaying it, but let the genuine respect for the team show through. Small pause before 'the younger team' — recognition that this matters to her too.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様、宛て名の確認、二重で、する習慣、社内、徹底してね、間違い防止に。
lines.en: I want the whole company to make double-checking customer names and addresses a habit. Let's make sure that becomes the standard across the board — it prevents mistakes.
lines.style: Clear directive wrapped in reasoning. Speak with quiet firmness on 'double-checking' — this is non-negotiable. The pace stays measured but purposeful. No performance, just clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人、簿記の研修、来週から、開始予定です、外部講師、お招きいたします。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to start the new employee bookkeeping training next week, and we've brought in an external instructor for it.
lines.style: Straightforward update, slightly formal in tone. Even delivery — this is logistical information he's proud of. No hesitation, just facts that show preparation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 終身的に、信頼される企業、目指していきましょうね、お客様にも、社員にも、両方。
lines.en: Let's keep working toward becoming a company our customers and our employees can trust for the long term. That's what matters.
lines.style: Settled, reflective tone. Speak with quiet conviction, not preaching. Let the weight of 'long term' and 'both' land — this is the real goal underneath the operations talk. Slightly softer on delivery, like she's looking forward together with him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。トラブルに、社員を、巻き込んでしまわないよう、社内体制、見直しております、最新版で。
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing the internal systems to make sure staff don't get caught up in any trouble, and we're working with the most current version of the protocols.
lines.style: Protective, detail-oriented. Lead with care — the protection of staff is the engine here. Even pace, but let the emphasis fall on 'don't get caught up' — that's the commitment. Close with quiet confidence on 'current version.'
